name: Fairmont Fujairah Beach Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort on Mina Al Fajer in Fujairah, with a modern bohemian, arabesque art deco design theme and views of the marina or the Gulf of Oman
best_for: Families who want a kids club, play area and water sports at the beach
Travelers who want sea views and a beach resort base in Fujairah

facts.text: The resort is located on Mina Al Fajer in Fujairah.
Guest rooms and suites have views of the marina or of the Gulf of Oman.
The Two Bedroom Suite has interconnecting rooms and a marina view, and is described as suited to 4 adults and 2 children.
Arteasan serves a High Afternoon Tea with savory bites, pastries and sweet treats.
Canvas Rooftop Pool Bar offers open-air dinners with sea views.
Copper Lobster serves a three-course coastal dining experience.
Dining includes all-day dining, a tea lounge, a seafood restaurant and a European-style bistro.
Wi-Fi is complimentary, with speed upgrades available.
Check-in is at 3:00PM and check-out is at 12:00PM.

highlights.text: The design theme combines modern bohemian elegance with arabesque-infused art deco.
One-bedroom suites have views of the sea and adjacent mountains, plus two balconies.
The pool is elaborately tiled and has sunset views across the sea.
Water sports include jet skiing and banana boat rides, as well as kayaks, paddleboards and sailing boats.
Lava Beach Club has beach and pool facilities, a kids club, a play area, face painting and games.

considerations.text: There is not much to do in the immediate neighborhood, as the area around the hotel is new.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires travel time to reach major attractions.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Fujairah Beach Resort
